headline: Copper One's 19.9 million special warrants convert into shares and warrants
dek: The automatic conversion, completing a September financing, hands holders new common shares plus warrants exercisable at $0.50 for two years.
caption: Copper One's September financing completes on November 6 as its special warrants convert automatically into shares and two-year warrants.

body: Copper One Resources Corp. (CSE: CEXY; OTC: CEXYF; FSE: IW8) will see 19,889,750 special warrants, issued September 29, 2026, automatically convert into common shares and warrants on November 6, 2026, the company said. The special warrants were issued in two tranches: 12,383,000 non-flow-through special warrants and 7,506,750 flow-through special warrants. Holders do not need to take any action; the conversion happens automatically under the terms of the original offering.

The conversion delivers a combined 19,889,750 common shares along with 9,944,875 share purchase warrants to the former special warrant holders. Each warrant entitles the holder to buy one common share at $0.50 for two years from the offering's closing date. The company may accelerate that two-year expiry on 30 days' notice if Copper One's shares trade at $1.25 or higher for five consecutive trading days on the Canadian Securities Exchange.

A prospectus supplement dated November 3, 2026 was filed to qualify the distribution of the securities underlying the special warrants in British Columbia, Alberta and Ontario, and is available on SEDAR+. It follows a short form base shelf prospectus the company filed in May 2025, as amended in March and October 2026. Copper One trades on the Canadian Securities Exchange under CEXY, on the US over-the-counter market under CEXYF, and on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange under IW8.

This release does not restate the price or use of proceeds from the original special warrant offering; it covers only the terms of today's automatic conversion and the prospectus supplement that qualifies the resulting shares and warrants for distribution.
